commands:
set -euo pipefail; expected=19d4419797e5c6d1f2229cd207b56b9b8385ef2d; actual=$(git rev-parse HEAD); echo HEAD=$actual; test "$actual" = "$expected"; /usr/bin/python3 scripts/check_runtime_config_ssot.py; root=$(pwd); tmp=$(mktemp -d); cat >"$tmp/CMakeLists.txt" <<EOF
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(growbox_eink_config NONE)
set(GROWBOX_APP_CLIMATE_V6_REAL_INPUTS 1)
set(GROWBOX_BOARD_PROFILE "crowpanel-esp32s3-2_9-n8r8" CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(GROWBOX_EINK_DISPLAY_ENABLED "1" CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
include("$root/config/runtime/GrowboxRuntimeConfig.cmake")
file(WRITE "\${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/pins.txt" "\${GROWBOX_EINK_SCLK_GPIO},\${GROWBOX_EINK_MOSI_GPIO},\${GROWBOX_EINK_CS_GPIO},\${GROWBOX_EINK_DC_GPIO},\${GROWBOX_EINK_RST_GPIO},\${GROWBOX_EINK_BUSY_GPIO},\${GROWBOX_EINK_POWER_GPIO}")
EOF
cmake -S "$tmp" -B "$tmp/build"; cat "$tmp/build/pins.txt"; test "$(cat "$tmp/build/pins.txt")" = "12,11,45,46,47,48,7"; bad=$(mktemp -d); cp "$tmp/CMakeLists.txt" "$bad/CMakeLists.txt"; sed -i '' '/include(/i\set(GROWBOX_EINK_MOSI_GPIO "21" CACHE STRING "" FORCE)' "$bad/CMakeLists.txt"; if cmake -S "$bad" -B "$bad/build" >"$bad/out.log" 2>&1; then cat "$bad/out.log"; echo expected GPIO conflict >&2; exit 1; fi; grep -q 'GPIO conflict' "$bad/out.log"; HOST_BUILD_JOBS=2 bash scripts/test_display_host.sh; git diff --check; test -z "$(git status --short)"
